vertebrae.extractors.base
=========================

.. py:module:: vertebrae.extractors.base

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   Feature extractor protocol.



Classes
-------

.. autoapisummary::

   vertebrae.extractors.base.FeatureExtractor


Module Contents
---------------

.. py:class:: FeatureExtractor

   Bases: :py:obj:`Protocol`


   Protocol implemented by all vertebrae feature extractors.

   .. attribute:: name

      User-facing extractor name.

   .. attribute:: modality

      Input modality handled by the extractor.

   .. attribute:: extractor_type

      Extractor family metadata.


   .. py:method:: fit(X, y = None)

      Fit extractor state when applicable.

      :param X: Input samples.
      :param y: Optional labels.

      :returns: The fitted extractor.



   .. py:method:: transform(X)

      Transform inputs into embeddings.

      :param X: Input samples.

      :returns: Dense or sparse numeric embedding matrix.



   .. py:method:: fit_transform(X, y = None)

      Fit the extractor and transform inputs into embeddings.

      :param X: Input samples.
      :param y: Optional labels.

      :returns: Dense or sparse numeric embedding matrix.



   .. py:method:: recipe()

      Return a serializable extractor recipe.

      :returns: JSON-compatible recipe used for cache keys and reports.
